# Casey Manos

> Personal website of Casey Manos, an engineer, runner, and builder.

## When to use this site
Use this site for Casey's own biography, resume, public projects and essays. Treat essays as personal accounts, not independently verified documentation for third-party products. Do not infer current availability or employment from an undated page. Contact Casey directly for confirmation.

## Reading content
Request any content page with Accept: text/markdown for a readable Markdown representation. HTML remains available with Accept: text/html. GET /api/profile returns public profile JSON without authentication. This is a read-only personal site, not a commercial service; no MCP server, account management, payment or write API is offered.

- [Home](https://caseymanos.com/)
- [Resume](https://caseymanos.com/resume/)
- [Writing](https://caseymanos.com/writings/)
- [Projects](https://caseymanos.com/projects/)
- [Casey Manos API documentation](https://caseymanos.com/docs/)
- [OpenAPI](https://caseymanos.com/openapi.json)
- [Sitemap](https://caseymanos.com/sitemap.xml)
- [Contact](https://caseymanos.com/contact/)
